{{lowercase}} {{Translated title}} ---- [[File:monpoké logo.png|thumb|Logo]] [[File:Monpoké poster.png|thumb|300px|monpoké Short Animation]] '''monpoké Short Animation''' (Japanese: '''モンポケショートアニメ''' ''monpoké Short Anime'') is a series of [[Pokémon animation|animated]] shorts for the official [[Pokémon]] baby brand, [[monpoké]]. It was announced on December 18, 2024, and consists of 10 episodes, each approximately five minutes long. Like the previous ''[[Fun Times on monpoké Island]]'' puppet show video series, the shorts feature {{p|Pikachu}} along with {{p|Dedenne}}, {{p|Mime Jr.}}, {{p|Smeargle}}, and {{p|Ludicolo}} on monpoké Island. Episodes are being released every Wednesday on the Japanese [[Pokémon Kids TV]] [[YouTube]] channel, with the first two episodes having been released on February 19, 2025. ==List of shorts== {{Episodelistheader|Pika}} {{Episodelistbody|None|None|[[#First Journey|はじめてのたび]]|First Journey|Unannounced|February 19, 2025|monpoké Short Animation short 1.png}} {{Episodelistbody|None|None|[[#First Outing|はじめてのおでかけ]]|First Outing|Unannounced|February 19, 2025|monpoké Short Animation short 2.png}} {{Episodelistbody|None|None|[[#First Heart-Pounding|はじめてのドキドキ]]|First Heart-Pounding|Unannounced|February 26, 2025|monpoké Short Animation short 3.png}} {{Episodelistbody|None|None|[[#First Smile|はじめてのえがお]]|First Smile|Unannounced|March 5, 2025|monpoké Short Animation short 4.png}} {{Episodelistbody|None|None|[[#First Training|はじめてのとっくん]]|First Training|Unannounced|March 12, 2025|monpoké Short Animation short 5.png}} {{Episodelistbody|None|None|[[#First Adventure|はじめてのぼうけん]]|First Adventure|Unannounced|March 19, 2025|monpoké Short Animation short 6.png}} {{Episodelistbody|None|None|[[#First Hero|はじめてのヒーロー]]|First Hero|Unannounced|March 26, 2025|monpoké Short Animation short 7.png}} {{Episodelistbody|None|None|[[#First Letter|はじめてのおてがみ]]|First Letter|Unannounced|April 2, 2025|monpoké Short Animation short 8.png}} {{Episodelistbody|None|None|[[#First Christmas|はじめてのクリスマス]]|First Christmas|Unannounced|April 9, 2025|monpoké Short Animation short 9.png}} {{Episodelistbody|None|None|[[#First Goodbye|はじめてのさよなら]]|First Goodbye|Unannounced|April 16, 2025|monpoké Short Animation short 10.png}} {{Episodelistfooterspecial|Pika|This concludes monpoké Short Animation.}} ==''First Journey''== [[File:monpoké Short Animation short 1.png|thumb|250px|Screenshot from ''First Journey'']] (Japanese: '''はじめてのたび''' ''First Journey'') is the first animated short.
